brief: Declares a kind of worker as a tag, the capabilities it serves and a budget of concurrent slots.
detail: Specialization is a budget, not a subclass: the resident engine is shared, so what separates one kind of worker from another is only what it serves and how much of the machine it may use at once. A profile admits work while a slot is free and refuses it otherwise, counting every decision, which isolates a heavy profile from a light one. A profile backed by an outside tool, such as OCR, is marked polyglot. A profile only declares and counts: it never starts a process.
example: #--> profile nlp [2/2 slots, serves sentiment, entities]
